license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice or attempt to offer to practice nursing or hold himself or herself forth as a licensed dietitian-nutritionist, as defined in this act, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unexpired, unrevoked and unsuspended license issued under this act.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Nursing.

name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Nursing.

type.quote: The State Board of Nursing shall consist of the Commissioner of Professional and Occupational Affairs, three members appointed by the Governor

umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the Department of State of the Commonwealth.

age_minimum.quote: Every applicant for examination as a licensed practical nurse shall furnish evidence satisfactory to the board that he or she is eighteen years of age or over

moral_character_required.quote: Every applicant, to be eligible for examination for licensure as a registered nurse, shall furnish evidence satisfactory to the Board that he or she is of good moral character

degree_required.value: approved program of professional nursing (associate degree, diploma, or baccalaureate degree for RN); at least twelve years of education and approved practical nursing program (not less than 1,500 hours/12 months) for LPN
degree_required.quote: Approved programs shall include baccalaureate degree, associate degree, diploma nursing programs and programs in transition from approved diploma- to degree-granting programs

accrediting_body.value: Board-approved programs; for CNS, national accrediting body for nursing education programs recognized by the board
accrediting_body.quote: Programs for the preparation of registered professional nurses shall be established or conducted only with the approval of the Board.

degree_level.quote: the Board shall not deny access to the examination for licensure as a registered nurse to a graduate of a State-approved associate degree, diploma or baccalaureate degree nursing program

school_approval_basis.quote: Programs for the preparation of registered professional nurses shall be established or conducted only with the approval of the Board.

credential_pegged.quote: has satisfactorily completed an approved program of professional nursing

tiers.quote: the Board shall not deny access to the examination for licensure as a registered nurse to a graduate of a State-approved associate degree, diploma or baccalaureate degree nursing program

has completed at least twelve years of education with diploma in public, parochial or private school, or its equivalent as evaluated by the Department of Education; and has satisfactorily completed a program in practical nursing prescribed and approved by the board in a school, hospital or other educational institution, of not less than fifteen hundred hours and within a period of not less than twelve months

a nurse shall not qualify for initial certification by the board under subsection (a) unless the nurse: (i) is a graduate of an accredited, board-approved master's or post-master's nurse practitioner program

a nurse shall not qualify for initial certification by the board unless the nurse holds a master's degree, doctoral degree or post-master's certificate from an educational program in nursing that has been approved by the board

a registered nurse shall not qualify for initial certification by the board unless the registered nurse holds a master's degree, doctoral degree or post-master's certificate from an accredited educational program in nurse anesthesia that has been approved by the board

required.quote: has satisfactorily completed an approved program of professional nursing

experience_source.quote: has satisfactorily completed an approved program of professional nursing

exams.name: Nursing licensure examination (RN)
exams.notes: Board examines applicants at least once per year; exam administered by qualified professional testing organization.
exams.quote: The Board shall, once every year and at such other times and under such conditions as shall be provided by its regulations, examine all eligible applicants for licensure

exams.name: Nursing licensure examination (LPN)
exams.notes: Board examines applicants twice each year.
exams.quote: The board shall twice each year and at such other times and under such conditions as shall be provided by its regulations examine all applicants eligible for examination to determine whether they are qualified to be licensed

exams.name: National certifying examination (CRNP)
exams.notes: Applicant must hold certification from a board-recognized national certification organization that required passing a national certifying examination.
exams.quote: holds certification as a certified registered nurse practitioner from a board-recognized national certification organization which required passing of a national certifying examination in the particular clinical specialty area

exams.name: National certifying examination (CRNA)
exams.notes: Applicant must hold current national certification from a board-recognized national certification organization requiring passing a national certifying examination in nurse anesthesia.
exams.quote: holds current national certification as a certified registered nurse anesthetist from a board-recognized national certification organization which required passing of a national certifying examination in nurse anesthesia

interval_years.quote: Licenses issued pursuant to this act shall expire on the thirty-first day of October of each biennium

required.quote: Beginning with the license period designated by regulation, licensees shall be required to attend and complete thirty (30) hours of mandatory continuing education during each two-year license period.

hours_per_period.quote: licensees shall be required to attend and complete thirty (30) hours of mandatory continuing education during each two-year license period.

period_years.quote: thirty (30) hours of mandatory continuing education during each two-year license period

value: For CRNPs who prescribe: at least 16 hours in pharmacology per two-year period
topical_requirements.quote: In the case of a certified registered nurse practitioner who is prescribing medical therapeutic or corrective measures pursuant to section 8.3, that continuing education must include at least sixteen (16) hours in pharmacology in that two-year period.

available.quote: The Board may issue a license without examination to a graduate of a school of nursing or a dietetics-nutrition program who has completed a course of study in nursing or dietetics-nutrition considered by the Board to be equivalent to that required in this State at the time such course was completed, and who is registered or licensed by examination in any other state, or territory of the United States or the Dominion of Canada

requirements.value: Equivalent course of study, licensure by examination in another state/territory/Dominion of Canada, good character, and preliminary education requirements met.
requirements.quote: who has completed a course of study in nursing or dietetics-nutrition considered by the Board to be equivalent to that required in this State at the time such course was completed, and who is registered or licensed by examination in any other state, or territory of the United States or the Dominion of Canada, and who has met all the foregoing requirements as to character, and preliminary education.

exists.quote: The State Board of Nursing shall consist of the Commissioner of Professional and Occupational Affairs, three members appointed by the Governor

national_certification.value: Board-recognized national certification organization (CRNP, CNS, CRNA)
national_certification.quote: holds certification as a certified registered nurse practitioner from a board-recognized national certification organization which required passing of a national certifying examination

national_association.value: American Nurses Association / American Nurses Credentialing Center
national_association.quote: submitting evidence of having current American Nurses Association or American Nurses Credentialing Center certification

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice or attempt to offer to practice nursing or hold himself or herself forth as a licensed dietitian-nutritionist, as defined in this act, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unexpired, unrevoked and unsuspended license issued under this act.

credential_type.quote: the Board shall issue to each person who meets the professional nursing licensure requirements of this act, a certificate setting forth that such person is licensed to engage in the practice of professional nursing and entitled to use the title "registered nurse" and the letters "R.N."

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice or attempt to offer to practice nursing or hold himself or herself forth as a licensed dietitian-nutritionist, as defined in this act, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unexpired, unrevoked and unsuspended license issued under this act.

title_protection.quote: No other person shall engage in the practice of professional nursing or use the titles "nurse" or "registered nurse" or the abbreviation "R.N." to indicate that the person using the same is a registered nurse

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to practice or attempt to offer to practice nursing or hold himself or herself forth as a licensed dietitian-nutritionist, as defined in this act, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unexpired, unrevoked and unsuspended license issued under this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee is on repeated occasions negligent or incompetent in the practice of professional nursing or dietetics-nutrition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee is on repeated occasions negligent or incompetent in the practice of professional nursing or dietetics-nutrition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee is unable to practice professional nursing with reasonable skill and safety due to mental or physical illness or substance dependence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee is unable to practice professional nursing with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of mental or physical illness or condition or physiological or psychological dependence upon alcohol, hallucinogenic or narcotic drugs or other drugs which tend to impair judgment or coordination

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has wilfully or repeatedly violated any provisions of the act or board regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has wilfully or repeatedly violated any of the provisions of this act or of the regulations of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has committed fraud or deceit in the practice of nursing or in securing admission to practice or nursing school.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has committed fraud or deceit in: (i) the practice of nursing, or in securing his or her admission to such practice or nursing school

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has been convicted of a felony or crime of moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been convicted, or has pleaded guilty, or entered a plea of nolo contendere, or has been found guilty by a judge or jury, of a felony or a crime of moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has had their license suspended or revoked or received other disciplinary action in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has his or her license suspended or revoked or has received other disciplinary action by the proper licensing authority in another state, territory, possession or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has acted in a manner presenting an immediate and clear danger to the public health or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has acted in such a manner as to present an immediate and clear danger to the public health or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee possessed, used, acquired or distributed a controlled substance or caution legend drug for other than an acceptable medical purpose.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee possessed, used, acquired or distributed a controlled substance or caution legend drug for other than an acceptable medical purpose.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has been guilty of immoral or unprofessional conduct, including departure from ethical or quality standards of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been guilty of immoral or unprofessional conduct. Unprofessional conduct shall include departure from or failing to conform to an ethical or quality standard of the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: LPN licensee is guilty of gross immorality.
LPN licensee is unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, habits or other causes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, habits or other causes;

disciplinary_grounds.description: LPN licensee continues to practice when knowing they have an infectious, communicable or contagious disease.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is continuing to practice nursing when such licensee knows he or she has an infectious, communicable or contagious disease;

insurance_required.quote: A certified registered nurse practitioner practicing in this Commonwealth shall maintain a level of professional liability coverage as required for a nonparticipating health care provider under the act of March 20, 2002 (P.L.154, No.13), known as the "Medical Care Availability and Reduction of Error (Mcare) Act"

definition_quote.value: The 'Practice of Professional Nursing' means diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential health problems through such services as casefinding, health teaching, health counseling, and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens as prescribed by a licensed physician or dentist.
definition_quote.quote: The "Practice of Professional Nursing" means diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential health problems through such services as casefinding, health teaching, health counseling, and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens as prescribed by a licensed physician or dentist.

value: provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being
executing medical regimens as prescribed by a licensed physician or dentist
acts of medical diagnosis (CRNP in collaboration with physician)
prescribing medical therapeutic or corrective measures (CRNP per § 8.3)
anesthesia services (CRNA under overall direction per § 8.9)
methods_authorized.quote: diagnosing and treating human responses to actual or potential health problems through such services as casefinding, health teaching, health counseling, and provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens as prescribed by a licensed physician or dentist

drug_authority.value: CRNPs may prescribe and dispense categories of drugs authorized by board regulations, subject to Drug Review Committee approval, when acting in collaboration with a physician per written agreement.
drug_authority.quote: A certified registered nurse practitioner who satisfies the requirements of subsection (a) may prescribe and dispense those categories of drugs that certified registered nurse practitioners were authorized to prescribe and dispense by board regulations in effect on the effective date of this section

license_tiers.quote: Any person who holds a license to practice professional nursing in this Commonwealth... shall have the right to use the titles "nurse" and "registered nurse" and the abbreviation "R.N."

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Certified registered nurse practitioner" means a registered nurse licensed in this Commonwealth who is certified by the board in a particular clinical specialty area.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: the performance of selected nursing acts in the care of the ill, injured or infirm under the direction of a licensed professional nurse, a licensed physician or a licensed dentist

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: is acting in collaboration with a physician as set forth in a written agreement which shall, at a minimum, identify the following: (i) the area of practice in which the nurse is certified; (ii) the categories of drugs from which the nurse may prescribe or dispense; and (iii) the circumstances and how often the collaborating physician will personally see the patient

full_independent_practice_available.quote: A certified registered nurse practitioner may perform acts of medical diagnosis in collaboration with a physician and in accordance with regulations promulgated by the board.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: A certified registered nurse practitioner may prescribe medical therapeutic or corrective measures if the nurse: (1) has successfully completed at least forty-five (45) hours of coursework specific to advanced pharmacology at a level above that required by a professional nursing education program; (2) is acting in collaboration with a physician as set forth in a written agreement

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: Auxiliary services rendered by persons carrying out duties necessary for the support of nursing service, including those duties which involve minor and very basic nursing services for patients, performed in health care facilities or elsewhere under the direction of licensed physicians or as delegated by licensed registered nurses and performed under the direction of professional nurses or licensed practical nurses.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: Any hospital or health care facility, peer or colleague who has substantial evidence that a professional has an active addictive disease for which the professional is not receiving treatment, is diverting a controlled substance or is mentally or physically incompetent to carry out the duties of his license shall make or cause to be made a report to the Board

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The Board may defer and ultimately dismiss any of the types of corrective action set forth in this act for an impaired professional so long as the licensee is progressing satisfactorily in an approved treatment program

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: "Overall direction" means oversight of anesthesia services and medical management of patient care by a qualified individual who is present and available onsite, but not necessarily present in the same procedure room as a certified registered nurse anesthetist performing anesthesia services for the duration of the services provided.

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: the categories of drugs from which the nurse may prescribe or dispense

nursing_education_program_clinical_hours.quote: has satisfactorily completed a program in practical nursing prescribed and approved by the board in a school, hospital or other educational institution, of not less than fifteen hundred hours and within a period of not less than twelve months
